headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.75
summary: A full Create New World screen replaces the flat-world tool — game mode, difficulty, cheats, gamerules and packs, stamped with the selected instance's version — and dialogs no longer push their buttons off-screen on small devices.

items.text: Create New World replaces Custom Flat World: choose game mode, difficulty, hardcore, seed, flat layers, gamerules, cheats and behavior/resource packs. Worlds are stamped with the selected instance's game version, and behavior packs no longer void achievements.
Dialog content is clamped to the screen height and made scrollable, so bottom buttons such as CANCEL/TRANSFER stay reachable on small devices.
